description: A painted interior of a rustic wooden room with a low beamed ceiling and small paned windows. A bearded man in a dark coat and broad-brimmed hat stands at a plank table covered with books, an inkwell and papers, pointing an arm toward another man. Around them, bearded men in broad hats and plain dark clothing gesture and react, some seated, some rising, one holding a hat in his hand. The mood is a tense argument. No visible text beyond blank-looking papers, no frame, and no violence.
